entries.Serve. A Credituz é um sistema operacion: It works. Credituz is a credit and billing operating system: any business that offers financing or collects recurring payments uses the entire platform. Car dealerships compare credit terms across banks and submit proposals digitally; property managers and landlords collect rent via direct debit, payment slips, Pix, and NFe; clinics, schools, and service providers with monthly fees automate collections and reconciliation. The core functions—comparing credit options, making offers, collecting payments, and reconciling accounts—are the same across all of them.
entries.Setup em 5 minutos, interface no padrão: Setup in 5 minutes, an interface based on the WhatsApp/Notion standard (which everyone is already familiar with), and no scheduled training. In addition to the knowledge base and video tutorials, the plan includes live chat support Monday through Friday, from 9 a.m. to 6 p.m., and the ability to open support tickets directly within the platform. The Enterprise plan includes a dedicated customer service representative.
entries.Seu cliente para de dividir orçamento en: Your client no longer has to split their budget between CRM, the WhatsApp call center, the credit simulator, and digital signatures. It’s all in a single system, and the monthly fee goes to you.
